entities.name: EPS RLOS attach
entities.description: An attach procedure where the UE requests access to restricted local operator services by setting the attach type to EPS RLOS attach in the ATTACH REQUEST message.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used by the UE to initiate attach procedures, including RLOS attach.

entities.name: Attach type
entities.description: Information element in ATTACH REQUEST message indicating the type of attach procedure.

entities.name: PLMN supports RLOS
entities.description: Condition where the PLMN is configured to support access to restricted local operator services, determined from broadcast system information.

entities.name: UE authenticated
entities.description: Condition where the UE has been successfully authenticated by the network.

entities.name: UE unauthenticated
entities.description: Condition where the UE has not been authenticated by the network.

entities.name: Limited service state
entities.description: EMM state where the UE has limited service capabilities.

entities.name: MME configured for RLOS
entities.description: Property indicating the MME is configured to support access to restricted local operator services.

entities.name: UE originated RLOS only
entities.description: Property restricting RLOS access to only UE-originated requests, with no mobile terminated access or network triggered service requests allowed.

entities.name: WB-S1 mode
entities.description: Condition where the UE is operating in WB-S1 mode, required for RLOS access.

relations.description: RLOS attach procedure involves sending an ATTACH REQUEST message.
ATTACH REQUEST message contains the attach type information element.
Setting attach type to EPS RLOS attach is guarded by the condition that the PLMN supports RLOS.
RLOS attach procedure requires the UE to be in limited service state.
If MME is configured for RLOS, it establishes that unauthenticated UEs can access RLOS.
If MME is configured for RLOS, it establishes that authenticated UEs can also access RLOS.
Property establishes that only UE-originated RLOS requests are supported.
RLOS attach procedure requires the UE to be in WB-S1 mode.
